caption: Sint-Gertrudiskerk, Workum
composition: Unfinished Gothic hall church and separate tower · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Gertrudiskerk at Workum is an unfinished late-Gothic hall church. The nave stops short of the tower, so a gap remains between them. The tower has two stages, a stair turret, and the 1613 crown of a lantern and an onion cupola, not a needle spire. The tower does not lean. It is overcast, about 11.7°C, with wind near 5.0 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The church is closed.
